51551339.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to 6x-His-TEV-tagged human MDM2 (17 to 111 residues) assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis
51551339.references_previous: Walsky, R. L.; Kung, A. L.; Escher, I.; Mala, T. J.; Barbuto, S.; Wright, R. D.; Wagner, G.; Verdi, G. L.; Korsmeyer, S. J. Activation of apoptosis in vivo by a hydrocarbon-stapled BH3 helix. Science (New York, N.Y.) 2004, 305 (5689), 1466–1470.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - MDM2 and MDMX Bi: MDM2 and MDMX binding assays for determination of Kd values were conducted by fluorescence polarization methods as previously described.19 Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assays to determine absolute Ka values and protein-peptide dissociation kinetics (koff and half-lives) were conducted by Xtal Inc. (Worcester, MA). MDM2 (6xHis-TEV-hMDM2(17–111)) and MDMX (6xHis-TEV-hMDMX(15–111)/(C17S)) proteins were manufactured as previously described.19 Binding studies were performed at 25 °C using a BioRad ProteOn XPR36 optical biosensor equipped with a high-capacity nickel-charged NTA sensor chip for capture of His-tagged MDM2 and MDMX and equilibrated with running buffer (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP, 5% glycerol, 0.005% Tween-20, 2% DMSO, pH 7.4). The sensor surface was regenerated with 0.5 M EDTA and recharged with 200 μM Ni2+ between capture cycles.
